title: 第2章 走别人的路，让别人无路可走！
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
如果你在其它地方的话，想要造炮那要和已经成名几十年，成为德国首富的克虏伯家族竞争，如果向要造枪，毛瑟兄弟会给你说道说道。如果要搞钢铁和煤炭的话，抱歉，巴伐利亚一不产铁，二不产煤炭，看看德国工业发达的地区，无论是鲁尔区还是从法国弄来的阿尔萨斯—洛林，亦或者萨尔区，这些地方要么有煤，要么有铁，要么同时有煤有铁！如果玩低端的重复竞争的话，巴伐利亚死都不知道怎么死的！
也许有人说后世不是有一个传说中BMW吗？没错，确实有这个公司，而且中文名还挺牛，被人称为宝马公司！但是实际上这哥们的前身不是搞汽车的啊，而且真正辉煌的时候也不是搞汽车啊！它的前身是巴伐利亚机械制药公司！成立于1916年，而且开始是搞飞机的！2战中也是搞飞机发动机的！著名的BMW801就是他生产的！虽说后世很辉煌，但是可惜的是1889年的德国，这个公司毛都没有啊！总体来说，巴伐利亚的工业还是比较落后的。至于说造船业或者航运业？内河航运还是可以玩玩的，造船的话，弄个设计局也是可以的，但是造船厂还是暂时缓缓吧，连海都没挨着啊！
所以年轻的王子给巴伐利亚制定的发展方向就是走高端路线，高端路线怎么走呢？内燃机、汽车、飞机、锅炉什么的还比较遥远，这些东西要么还没有，要么是搞出来后再巴伐利亚内部还能卖的动，出去就被人家其它地方的企业打得屁滚尿流，工业底蕴差一些，而且穿越者不咋懂的东西。那确实没办法，需要慢慢补，需要国家扶持。但是有些东西偏重于技巧，或者说作为穿越者对某些东西比较熟悉的话，那倒是可以试试，比如说后世闻名的克虏伯装甲！
说起1战前的克虏伯装甲，一般对战舰史有些了解的人都会下意识的想到1893年诞生并且用在勃兰登堡号战列舰上的克虏伯硬化装甲，但是实际上，克虏伯搞装甲的历史要更早，而且过程更加复杂！
克虏伯刚开始搞装甲是和别人一起搞的，那时候的克虏伯不要说完全自产装甲了，在1890年前克虏伯连自己的轧钢厂都没有！当时是克虏伯的合作伙伴思特姆—哈尔贝格男爵负责生产，并且允许克虏伯用老式的“威尔生法”来制造钢面铁甲，克虏伯则负责新型装甲的研发。而克虏伯在1890年的时候才开始研制镍钢装甲。
而时间点到了这个时候，就不得不提大洋彼岸的某个大国了，世界上第一种硬化装甲就是美国人奥古斯塔.哈维搞出来的哈维硬化装甲。而这哥们开始也不是从头到尾一条龙式生产，美国人最初的硬化装甲用的板材是从法国施耐德厂进口的镍钢装甲，然后经过渗碳和浸入冷水中处理后得到了最早的哈维硬化装甲。
而哈维装甲的出现直接横扫舰用装甲界！高达50%甚至100%的利润率让所有的军火商人趋之若鹜！这么大一块蛋糕放在眼前，克虏伯自然也不会放弃，克虏伯就想了，哥哥我80年代就已经把镍矿用在了铸炮方面。现在不就是用将类似的技术用在装甲上吗？法国鸡和美国牛仔都能搞出来，我为什么搞不出来？
于是历史上克虏伯在1890年球开始搞镍钢装甲，并且在1891年获得成功。随后克虏伯再接再砺，将经过一周渗碳热处理硬化后的镍钢装甲再放到油中进行处理，从而得到了早期的克虏伯硬化装甲，据说比哈维硬化装甲要强10%左右！而到了这个时候还不算完，克虏伯硬化装甲最后的集大成者是一种被称为“瓦斯胶合法”的硬化方式，用含碳素的胶质放在装甲表明，然后再加热硬化，最后喷水完成最后的硬化过程。

content_en:
If you are in other places and want to build cannons, you will have to compete with the Krupp family, which has been famous for decades and has become the richest man in Germany. If you want to build guns, the Mauser Brothers will tell you. If you want to engage in steel and coal, sorry, Bavaria does not produce iron or coal. Look at the industrially developed areas in Germany, whether it is the Ruhr area, Alsace-Lorraine brought from France, or the Saarland area. These places either have coal, iron, or both coal and iron! If we play low-end repeated competition, Bavaria will die without knowing how!
Maybe some people say that there will be a legendary BMW in later generations? Yes, this company does exist, and its Chinese name is quite awesome. It is called BMW Company! But in fact, this guy’s predecessor was not a car maker, and he wasn’t a car maker when he was truly brilliant! Its predecessor was the Bavarian Machinery Pharmaceutical Company! It was founded in 1916, and it started out as an airplane manufacturer! They also worked on aircraft engines in World War 2! The famous BMW801 was produced by him! Although it was very glorious in later generations, it was a pity that in Germany in 1889, this company had no hair! Generally speaking, Bavaria's industry is still relatively backward. As for the shipbuilding or shipping industry? Inland shipping can still be played, and for shipbuilding, it is also possible to set up a design bureau, but the shipyard should slow down for the time being, and it is not even close to the sea!
Therefore, the development direction set by the young prince for Bavaria is to take the high-end route. How to take the high-end route? Internal combustion engines, automobiles, airplanes, boilers, etc. are still relatively far away. These things either don't exist yet, or they can be sold in Bavaria once they are developed, but they will be beaten to the ground by companies in other places. The industrial background is poor, and the travelers do not understand it well. There is really nothing we can do about it, we need to make up for it slowly and need support from the state. But some things focus on skills, or if you are familiar with certain things as a time traveler, you can try it, such as the famous Krupp armor in later generations!
Speaking of Krupp armor before World War 1, people who generally know something about the history of battleships will subconsciously think of the Krupp hardened armor that was born in 1893 and used on the battleship Brandenburg. However, in fact, the history of Krupp armor is earlier, and the process is more complicated!
When Krupp first started working on armor, it was done together with others. At that time, not to mention that Krupp was completely producing its own armor. Before 1890, Krupp didn't even have its own steel rolling mill! At that time, Krupp's partner Baron Sturm-Halberg was responsible for production and allowed Krupp to use the old "Wilson method" to manufacture steel-faced armor. Krupp was responsible for the research and development of new armor. Krupp only began to develop nickel steel armor in 1890.
At this point in time, we have to mention a certain big country on the other side of the ocean. The world's first hardened armor was the Harvey hardened armor developed by American Augusta Harvey. And this guy didn’t start with one-stop production from beginning to end. The Americans’ initial hardened armor plates were nickel steel armor imported from the Schneider factory in France. They were then carburized and immersed in cold water to get the earliest Harvey hardened armor.
The emergence of Harvey armor directly swept the ship armor industry! Profit rates as high as 50% or even 100% attract all arms dealers! With such a big piece of cake in front of him, Krupp naturally would not give up. Krupp thought, my brother and I have already used nickel ore to cast cannons in the 1980s. Isn’t similar technology used on armor now? French chickens and American cowboys can do it, why can’t I do it?
So historically, Krupp began to develop nickel steel armor in 1890, and succeeded in 1891. FollowLater, Krupp continued to work hard and put the nickel steel armor hardened after a week of carburizing heat treatment into oil for treatment, thus obtaining the early Krupp hardened armor, which is said to be about 10% stronger than Harvey hardened armor! And it's not over yet at this point. The final master of Krupp's hardened armor is a hardening method called the "gas glue method". Carbon-containing glue is placed on the surface of the armor, then heated and hardened, and finally water is sprayed to complete the final hardening process.
